# Livery

> Livery is a car ownership app for drivers in the UK: a private digital garage. You add a car by its registration and Livery keeps everything about owning it in one place: MOT, tax, insurance and service dates with reminders, a service and repair history file, modifications and their power gains, running costs down to the cost per mile, and documents and photos. It is open to everyone on the web at https://app.liveryclub.com, with iPhone and Android apps coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.

Pricing: Livery Free covers up to two cars with MOT and tax lookups, key date countdowns and reminders, service history, mods, running costs and documents. Livery Plus costs £5.99 a month or £49.99 a year (launch offer: £39.99 a year, kept for as long as you stay subscribed, for anyone who subscribes before the end of 31 January 2027) and adds Ask Livery (an AI car helper that answers from your own records and reads photos, invoices and PDFs), unlimited cars, receipt scanning, fuel economy and MPG tracking with drop alerts, an MOT advisory tracker, a clean air zone and ULEZ check, a business mileage log at HMRC rates, and shared garages for family and partners. Livery Plus also includes a car valuation every month. Anyone can run a full vehicle history check (stolen, outstanding finance, insurance write-offs, scrapped or exported, plate and keeper changes, mileage records) from "Buying a car?" in the app: £5.99, or £3.99 with Livery Plus, and yearly Plus includes 3 checks a year. Reports stay saved in the user's account. Smart nudges to log fuel and costs are coming to every plan.

Livery is made by Chakraborty Group LTD in the UK. Data is stored on servers in London, each account can only see its own garage, and accounts can be deleted at any time.

## Key pages

- [Livery home](https://liveryclub.com/): what Livery does, pricing and frequently asked questions.
- [Livery web app](https://app.liveryclub.com/): sign up free and add a car by its registration.
- [Livery Plus and pricing](https://liveryclub.com/#pricing): Free and Plus plans compared feature by feature.
- [Car ownership guides](https://liveryclub.com/guides/): all guides.
- [Guide: used car checks before you buy](https://liveryclub.com/guides/used-car-checks-before-buying/): the complete UK checklist, from free MOT and tax checks to stolen, finance and write-off checks, the V5C, VIN, test drive, paying safely and buyers' rights.
- [Guide: Cat S and Cat N write-off categories](https://liveryclub.com/guides/cat-s-cat-n-write-off-categories/): what categories A, B, S and N mean, the old Cat C and D, and how to buy a written-off car safely.
- [Guide: how to spot a clocked car](https://liveryclub.com/guides/spot-clocked-car-mileage/): checking mileage history, the law, physical signs of high mileage and what to do if you've bought one.
- [Guide: car tax and MOT due dates](https://liveryclub.com/guides/car-tax-and-mot-due-dates/): checking both dates, MOT rules, car tax rates from April 2026, paying monthly and penalties.
- [Guide: how to check your car's MOT history](https://liveryclub.com/guides/check-mot-history/): checking MOT history for free, what dangerous, major, minor and advisory items mean, and what to look for when buying.
- [Guide: ULEZ and UK clean air zones](https://liveryclub.com/guides/ulez-clean-air-zone-check/): the Euro 4 petrol and Euro 6 diesel standards, London ULEZ, English clean air zones that charge cars, and Scotland's low emission zones.
- [Guide: car service history](https://liveryclub.com/guides/car-service-history/): full vs partial history, independent garages and warranties, service intervals and what records to keep.
- [Privacy Policy](https://app.liveryclub.com/privacy): what data Livery collects and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://app.liveryclub.com/terms)
- [Cookie Policy](https://app.liveryclub.com/cookies)
